entries.title: Gaia 21: mobile UX + dark mode + chat/notes
changes: Added an in-game chat and private notes panel - a floating icon opens a collapsible chat/notes panel (desktop) or full-screen view (mobile), with its own chat visible to players and spectators, and private per-game notes only you can see
The lobby's activity line now shows when someone joins an open-lobby game (e.g. "Luke joined the game")
Players can now delete their own solo test games immediately from the lobby
Idle test games are now automatically cleaned up after a week
Dark mode's background is now a softer dark gray instead of pure black

Fixed a dark-mode bug where the 7th advanced tech tile and other tech tiles rendered with inverted (near-invisible) colors, caused by a nested-svg-in-svg double-inversion in the whole-page dark-mode filter
Fixed dark-mode text (Charge 3 power label, scoring-extension label) staying hardcoded black and disappearing against the dark background

Investigated the mobile sticky-bar float-on-scroll report for spectators; confirmed the known pinch-zoom bug is already fixed in both Commands.vue and PremoveBar.vue, and confirmed the canPlay-unlocked-for-spectators behavior is intentional and server-enforced safe, not a bug

entries.title: Hosted persistence repair

entries.title: Hosted faction-pick persistence
